description: Bourdin AT2 quadrature fracture energy recomputation on mesh C5 across states
scientific_finding: Fracture energy recomputation across all states confirms that the non-matching C4 -> C5 mesh transfer inherently exhibits a -2.110% discrepancy at the initial mapped checkpoint d_ckpt (0.134830 mJ vs 0.137737 mJ), prior to any continuation step. Solving the exact bound-constrained variational inequality increases local damage dissipation monotonically (E_local rises from 0.091541 mJ to 0.093408 mJ, +2.039%), but elliptic gradient smoothing reduces E_grad from 0.043289 mJ to 0.041475 mJ (-4.190%), yielding a net total fracture energy of 0.134883 mJ (-2.072% vs donor). Because this -2.072% deficit exceeds the <= 2.0% threshold, Gate C1-2 strictly fails and must remain NOT_QUALIFIED.
